config.noDataMessage: Click a RED hydrant on the map to adopt it. Provide your information and then click Update. The change could take up to a minute to display.

config.text:
There are over 1,400 fire hydrants in Wellesley and each one is potentially vital in the event of an emergency. By adopting a hydrant and keeping it clear of snow this winter season, you will be assisting the Wellesley Department of Public Works and Fire Department in their emergency efforts.


Zoom to the location where you would like to adopt a hydrant or search for an address using the search bar.


Click a RED hydrant on the map to adopt it. Provide your information and then click Update.


The GREEN hydrants have already been adopted. Click on them to view their adoption information.

The Town of Wellesley provides this data for your use as a resource for general information "as is." The data provided here are for illustration purposes only and are not suitable for site-specific decision making. Information found here should not be used for making financial or any other commitments.


The Town of Wellesley provides this information with the understanding that it is not guaranteed to be accurate, correct or complete, and conclusions drawn from such information are the responsibility of the user. While every effort has been made to ensure the accuracy, correctness and timeliness of materials presented, the Town of Wellesley assumes no responsibility for errors or omissions, even if the Town of Wellesley is advised of the possibility of such damage. The data may have a number of errors, which may include, but are not limited to, the following types of errors:


• Spatial errors: The areas depicted by these maps are approximate, and are not necessarily accurate to surveying or engineering standards. X/Y coordinates may be in error by several feet or more.


• Attribute errors: Database information may be incorrect.


• Currency errors: GIS data layers, databases and documents may not be the most current available. All data is subject to constant change. Data input lags real-world changes by varying periods of time.


• Completeness errors: Data may be missing or data may be included that does not belong.


If you have any issues or find any data that you believe is inaccurate, please contact gis@wellesleyma.gov.
